name: Garbanzo Bean Chocolate Cake
description: A moist chocolate cake (or cupcakes) made by blending garbanzo beans with eggs and melted chocolate, topped with chocolate frosting.
keywords: chocolate cake, garbanzo beans, chickpeas, cupcakes
recipeIngredient: 1 1/2 cups semi-sweet or dark chocolate chips
2 cans (15 oz each) garbanzo beans, drained and rinsed

recipeInstructions.name: Preheat and prep
recipeInstructions.text: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Grease and flour a 9x13-inch baking pan.

recipeInstructions.name: Melt the chocolate
recipeInstructions.text: In a small bowl, melt 1 1/2 cups chocolate chips in the microwave for about 2 minutes, stirring frequently until smooth.

recipeInstructions.name: Blend beans and eggs
recipeInstructions.text: In a blender, blend 2 cans (15 oz each) drained and rinsed garbanzo beans with 6 eggs until creamy.

recipeInstructions.name: Finish the batter
recipeInstructions.text: Add 1 1/2 cups sugar, 2 Tbsp cocoa powder, 1 Tbsp lemon juice, 1 1/2 tsp baking powder, 3/4 tsp baking soda, 1 tsp vanilla and the melted chocolate, and blend well. If your blender isn't big enough, pour into a bowl to mix.

recipeInstructions.name: Bake
recipeInstructions.text: Pour the batter into the prepared pan and bake at 350°F for about 40 to 45 minutes, until a toothpick in the center comes out with moist crumbs. Do not overbake.

recipeInstructions.name: Frost
recipeInstructions.text: Cool completely, then frost with chocolate frosting.
